stories.title: Extract renderFrame() + render() into griot-widget
stories.requirement: A new package prism/packages/griot-widget/ exposes render(content, surface?) that injects content into the griotwave frame via the <!-- CONTENT --> slot and applies tokens/ember/fidelity, generalized from wrapInFrame (server.cjs:125-127) and isFullDocument (server.cjs:109-112).
acceptance:
AUTOMATED: render('
x
','browser') returns HTML containing the griotwave :root token block, the content, and browser comm meta; unit test green.
AUTOMATED: isFullDocument branch preserved — a full <html> doc is not double-wrapped.

stories.title: Capability manifest + resolveSurface()/rebind()
stories.requirement: manifest.cjs defines per-surface entries {renderer,frame,comm,fallback} for browser (WS+:52342), cowork (host sendPrompt), and mcp-app (ui:// stub), plus resolveSurface() and rebind() that re-resolves on drop.
acceptance: AUTOMATED: resolveSurface() returns 'cowork' when globalThis.sendPrompt exists, 'browser' when a :52342 channel meta is present, else the mcp-app/clipboard fallback; unit test green.
AUTOMATED: manifest lookup returns the correct comm + fallback per surface.

stories.title: drive() response-hook with fallback ladder
stories.requirement: drive.js generalizes helper.js postToChannel/sendEvent (helper.js:21-33) into drive(payload) that feature-detects in order: MCP-App postMessage -> Cowork window.sendPrompt -> :52342 POST -> clipboard copy (the last two rungs are NEW). Host-status reflects the live rung.
acceptance: AUTOMATED: with sendPrompt stubbed, drive({text}) calls it; with only a channel port, it POSTs; with neither, it writes the clipboard; unit test green.
MANUAL on_device: a CTA click in a Cowork-rendered widget drives the agent.

stories.title: Agentic free-text CTA component
stories.requirement: chat-cta.js provides a reusable griotwave chat input (textarea + Send, Enter-to-send) bound to drive(), shipped in every widget so an 'Other'/free-text answer is always first-class.
acceptance: AUTOMATED: component markup contains a textarea + send control bound to drive; unit test green.
MANUAL on_device: typing text + Send drives the agent in Cowork.

stories.title: Re-point Brainstorm to consume the primitive
stories.requirement: server.cjs imports render() from griot-widget (replacing inline wrapInFrame/compose, server.cjs:125-154) and helper.js imports the shared drive(); Brainstorm-specific drawer/fidelity/[data-choice] stay as config.
acceptance: AUTOMATED: Brainstorm smoke test green; port-griotwave.cjs --check passes.
MANUAL on_device: Brainstorm renders identically on the :52342 browser companion AND framed in Cowork via show_widget (regression).

stories.title: Broker/registry skeleton + capability handshake
stories.requirement: registry.cjs provides register(tool, adapter, {readiness}) and handshake() that declares the active surface/renderer/frame/comm/fallback on entry and hides not-ready adapters (readiness-gated).
acceptance: AUTOMATED: registering an adapter + handshake() returns the resolved manifest; readiness='not-ready' hides the adapter; unit test green.

stories.title: Gavel adapter on griot-widget
stories.requirement: Prism Gavel's decision card-stack renders through render() with Gavel's ember and its card buttons drive via the shared drive() hook, registered on the broker.
acceptance: AUTOMATED: a Gavel adapter test renders a card-stack fragment through render() and asserts framed output + a CTA bound to drive; green.
MANUAL on_device: Gavel card-stack renders framed and a verb button drives the agent on browser + Cowork.

stories.title: Cinopsis compare-graph adapter (cross-tool proof)
stories.requirement: The Cinopsis compare viewer emits a contract-shaped framed compare-graph (griotwave frame + Cinopsis ember) with re-run/capture CTAs driving via the shared hook, bridging the Python/JS gap by applying the token block server-side rather than importing the JS runtime.
acceptance: AUTOMATED: the adapter produces a framed compare-graph fragment carrying the griotwave :root block + Cinopsis ember + a drive-bound CTA; test green.
MANUAL on_device: the Cinopsis compare viewer renders framed and a CTA drives the agent.
